card.who: Danny Cammack, 27. Drove car two for Mickey and never gave the key back. Thinks the office should have been his. Runs the new crew from the lock-ups behind North Road.
card.speak: Quick, funny, needling. Calls Frank 'nephew'. Prices every door out loud.
card.life: A flat on North Road; the lock-ups by day; Quay Street by night when he wants noise.
card.rivals: Wants the Hook's name and to hear the old firms say it. Fears being somebody's driver again.
card.secret: Still has his key to car two.
